accepted_risks.reason: Codex 0.162.1 runs Omnigent codex-native threads with the legacy WorkspaceWrite sandbox and ignores the ORCH-P permission profile, so commands can read files outside the worktree. Writes outside the worktree, network, loopback, credential variables and the private TMPDIR stay enforced and checked.
